class.name: JRPGRandomStreams
class.brief_description: The game's independent random number streams.
class.description: Holds one [JRPGRandom] per purpose: battle, map AI, encounters, loot and miscellaneous. Each stream is independent, so drawing numbers for one purpose never changes the results of another; for example, a battle gives the same results however many steps the NPCs took before it.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Restores the streams found in [param data] (as written by [method serialize]). Streams missing from [param data] keep their state. Returns [code]false[/code] if an entry is malformed.

method.name: get_stream_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param stream] as used by [method serialize].

method.name: seed_all
method.description: Seeds every stream from [param seed], each with its own sequence.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns the state of every stream as a [Dictionary] of stream name to state.

constants.constant: Everything else, such as random values set by events.
